rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for the self as a psychological or personality-related part of a person.

example.english: They let their ego get too big, which makes it hard to get along with them.
example.traditional: 佢成日將自我放得太大，搞到同人相處好辛苦。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zoeng1 zi6 ngo5 fong3 dak1 taai3 daai6 gaau2 dou3 tung4 jan4 soeng1 cyu2 hou2 san1 fu2

rows.note: Use this when “ego” means a person's self-esteem, especially when it can be hurt or boosted.

example.english: Losing the match this time really hurt my ego.
example.traditional: 今次輸咗比賽，真係好傷自尊心。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 syu1 zo2 bei2 coi3 zan1 hai6 hou2 soeng1 zi6 zyun1 sam1
